_README: Goldened two-layer shim gap inventory. See test/shim-surface.test.cjs for what
this is and why it is a reviewed MAP rather than a must-be-empty gate.
Regenerate with UPDATE_GOLDEN=1, and add a note below for anything new.
Measured against the EXTRACTED cli.cjs (~21MB), never the 255MB Bun binary.

_notes.intl: NOT a node builtin — libexec/node-shim/modules/intl.cjs backs the Intl GLOBAL, not a require()able module, so neither side can enumerate it by name. Allowed, not a gap.
_notes.Bun.SQL: FIXED (no longer a layer1 gap, kept as history). Was an ACTIVE DIVERGENCE: upstream guards it with `if (typeof Bun > "u") throw Error("claude gateway requires the native binary")`, TRUE under real node ("undefined" > "u") but FALSE under quaude because bun-shim defines a Bun global at all — so the guard was defeated and `new Bun.SQL(...)` produced a bare `Bun.SQL is not a constructor` instead. bun-shim.cjs now gives Bun.SQL a throwing constructor that hands back upstream's own message verbatim. Reachability: confirmed NOT on the -p/interactive routes — Bun.SQL is used only inside the `claude gateway --config <path>` subcommand (a separate commander-registered enterprise auth/telemetry server), the sole call site in the bundle. See test/bun-shim-sql-guard.test.cjs.
_notes.Bun.WebView: BENIGN, and a good example of the shape we want: guarded by `"WebView" in Bun`, correctly false under the shim, so the branch is skipped and the function returns false. Feature detection that works. UNMEASURABLE, not merely unreached: CLODE_SHIM_PROBE (libexec/node-shim/internal/probe.cjs) wraps only node:* builtins loaded through loader.cjs's loadBuiltin() (its sole installProbe call site is loader.cjs:231) — libexec/bun-shim.cjs (the Bun.* global / bun: modules) has no probe instrumentation at all. This layer1 gap can never be armed by any corpus under the current probe design, so the BENIGN verdict above rests on code audit alone, not on measured reachability. See test/shim-surface/reachability.json's `probe_scope_limitation` and `unmeasurable` fields.
_notes.bun:jsc: BENIGN. One site: `try { let {heapStats} = await import("bun:jsc") ... } catch {}` for heap diagnostics. The rejection is caught, so a missing module degrades to no heap stats, matching any non-Bun host. UNMEASURABLE, not merely unreached: same probe-scope limitation as Bun.WebView above — libexec/bun-shim.cjs is not instrumented by CLODE_SHIM_PROBE, so this layer1 gap can never be armed by any corpus regardless of whether the bundle reaches it. See test/shim-surface/reachability.json's `probe_scope_limitation` and `unmeasurable` fields.
_notes.bun:sqlite: DRIFT, not a gap: bun-shim declares an interceptor for it in PROVIDES but bundle 2.1.218 never imports it. Harmless dead weight; listed so the declaration's drift stays visible instead of silently accumulating.
_notes.http.request / https.request / net.creat: DECLARED WALLS — the same ones test/node-shim-wall-tripwires.test.cjs alarms on, rediscovered here independently without being told they exist. That rediscovery is the main evidence this map works. They throw branded node-shim errors rather than failing silently. MEASURED (phase 2 Task 4, reachability.json dated 2026-08-04 against bundle 2.1.218): unarmed across all three corpora that ran (apicheck, agentic, interactive) — see reachability.json's `unarmed` list. This is corpus coverage, not a clean negative: per reachability.json's `corpus_blind_spots`, agentic runs against a MOCKED Anthropic server so it structurally cannot exercise real TLS/HTTP client paths; apicheck's credentialed branch hung (RECIPE.md G6, see the crypto.* note below) before reaching whatever lies past it; interactive captures only a 10s no-keystroke initial paint (no typed turn, no tool use).
_notes.crypto.*: The largest cluster (X509Certificate, createPrivateKey/PublicKey, createSign/createVerify, sign, pbkdf2/pbkdf2Sync, KeyObject). MEASURED (phase 2 Task 4, reachability.json dated 2026-08-04 against bundle 2.1.218): unarmed across every corpus that ran (apicheck, agentic, interactive) — see reachability.json's `unarmed` list and `unarmed_meaning`. NAMED BLIND SPOT, not evidence of unreachability: the ONLY corpus that even attempts the credentialed branch — apicheck's -p items, seeded that run with a COPY of a real ~/.claude/.credentials.json, deleted immediately after — HUNG on the quaude side before completing a turn (naude: exit 0 both items; quaude: apicheck's own 60s timeout fired, status:143). This reproduces RECIPE.md G6 (previously believed darwin-ppc/Darwin-8-specific) on darwin-arm64 — see reachability.json's `apicheck` corpus entry (`note`, `perItem`). The crypto.* cluster is exactly where credentialed token-refresh / enterprise-auth (mTLS, Vertex/Bedrock) handling would live, so "unarmed" here means "we could not get far enough down the credentialed path to find out", NOT "the path does not use them". RECIPE.md G4 already flags that auth path as unverified. Phase-3's recommended next step (reachability.json's `phase3_recommendation`) is an isolated HOME seeded with a syntactically-valid FIXTURE credentials file — unrelated to any real account — to take the credentialed branch deliberately and safely, without hanging and without borrowing a real token.
_notes.fs.fchmodSync / fs.fstat / fs.ReadStream: FIXED (no longer layer2 gaps, kept as history). Were fd-flavored variants of things the shim DOES provide by path (chmodSync, statSync, createReadStream) — same class as the FileHandle.chmod gap that broke Edit, which is precisely why this map exists. fchmodSync now tracks fd->path at fs.openSync/close and chmods that path (no fd-based fchmod primitive in the sync-fs patch, same strategy FileHandle.chmod already used); fstat routes through the existing fstatSync via cbWrap; ReadStream is now a real class fs.createReadStream() constructs, not a lookalike. See test/node-shim-fs-fd-variants.test.cjs.
_notes.fs.watch: test/fidelity/RECIPE.md row C7 remains UNVERIFIED — nothing in this file or in reachability.json answers it; do not read the absence of an `fs.watch` entry anywhere in this measurement as a clean result. fs.watch is not a golden gap at all: it is a PRESENT property on the shim's fs, a never-firing stub (`fsMod.watch` in libexec/node-shim/modules/fs.cjs), verified `'watch' in fs === true` and `typeof fs.watch === 'function'`. CLODE_SHIM_PROBE fires ONLY on ABSENT properties (`!(prop in target)`, libexec/node-shim/internal/probe.cjs lines 39 and 45) — so an access to a PRESENT-but-stubbed API like this one structurally cannot arm the probe in either direction, and grepping reachability.json for "fs.watch" always comes back empty, proving nothing about reachability. This probe is structurally blind to PRESENT-BUT-STUBBED APIs generally, not just this one. Answering C7 needs a different instrument: a logging wrapper on the EXISTING stub recording whether any of its four known bundle call sites (jobStateNameSync, useBgSessionPr, an unref'd private-field watcher, vendored chokidar) ever arms a listener on the -p / interactive routes.
_notes.child_process.fork / ChildProcess: fork() has no meaning under tjs (no node child bootstrap). If a reachable path ever forks, that is a design question, not a missing function. MEASURED (phase 2 Task 4, reachability.json dated 2026-08-04 against bundle 2.1.218): unarmed across apicheck/agentic/interactive. Per reachability.json's `corpus_blind_spots`, agentic's four scripted flows (Bash, Edit, Workflow, subagent, MCP-ws) do not exercise child_process.fork by construction — a coverage gap in the corpus, not a confirmed absence in the bundle. Not probed on the credentialed apicheck path either (hung at G6, see crypto.* note above).
_notes.stream.Duplex: FIXED (no longer a layer2 gap, kept as history). Was reads-only (6), no calls — likely instanceof / prototype checks. Implemented as a real ES class in libexec/node-shim/modules/stream.cjs (phase 2 Task 5), modeled on the AWS SDK's ChecksumStream shape found verbatim in the extracted bundle. MEASURED armed: all three corpora that ran (apicheck, agentic, interactive) per reachability.json's `armed` map, `tracked_in_golden: true`.
_notes.v8.* / perf_hooks.monitorEventLoopDelay: diagnostics and telemetry; absent means no stats, not broken behavior. MEASURED (phase 2 Task 4, reachability.json dated 2026-08-04 against bundle 2.1.218): unarmed across apicheck/agentic/interactive. Per reachability.json's `corpus_blind_spots`, the agentic corpus's four scripted flows don't exercise v8 heap stats or perf_hooks.monitorEventLoopDelay by construction. Not probed on the credentialed apicheck path either (hung at G6, see crypto.* note above).
